meta.name: Off Campus
meta.description: Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: A hockey-averse music major and Briar U's womanizing star center strike an unlikely deal to get her crush's attention and his grades up.

videos.title: The Practice
videos.overview: Hannah and Garrett's faux relationship is put to the test as they are forced to share a room at an overnight house party.

videos.title: The Orgasm
videos.overview: Just as Hannah and Garrett's deal begins working like a charm, Hannah ups the stakes by redefining the terms.

videos.title: The Breakup
videos.overview: Hannah and Garrett get closer than either anticipated and things get messy when they're forced to confront their feelings at Drunk Shakespeare.

videos.title: The Cold Turkey
videos.overview: Garrett brings Hannah home for Thanksgiving while Tucker hosts an epic Friendsgiving at the Off Campus house.

videos.title: The Breakaway
videos.overview: At a hockey fundraiser, Garrett and Logan butt heads, Hannah and Justin's musical collaboration encounters its biggest hurdle, and romance simmers.

videos.title: The Faceoff
videos.overview: Hannah confronts her past while Garrett faces the most challenging game of his season and Allie meets her hero.

videos.title: The Line Change
videos.overview: As the semester ends, fallout from the St. Anthony's game rattles the Hawks, and Hannah strives to find her voice.
